text: {"components": [{"type": "entity", "quote": "Albert Rösti", "gist": "Swiss Federal Councillor"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Marina Silva", "gist": "Brazilian Minister of Environment and Climate"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Jean-Noël Barrot", "gist": "French Minister of Telecommunications and Digitalisation"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Le Brésil aspire à jouer un rôle plus important au niveau international dans la protection du climat et à rendre son économie plus durable.", "gist": "Brazil aims to play a larger international role in climate protection and make its economy more sustainable."}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Le gouvernement brésilien souhaite organiser l’une des prochaines conférences mondiales sur le climat dans la région de forêt tropicale.", "gist": "The Brazilian government wants to host one of the upcoming global climate conferences in the tropical rainforest region."}]}
